g.text: Pack, DRG and charter configuration schemas — decided design (ADR-0048…ADR-0052)
parent_pack : string [ULID pattern; lineage only, sets no load order]
glossary_scope is retired (ADR-0049 d11): scope comes from the pack level.
Token spelling is snake_case (mission_type, anti_pattern, event_registry)
vocabulary targets glossary and term (ADR-0049 d4).
<glossary plural> is not spelled by ADR-0049 (follow-up #114).
selected_mission_types and selected_anti_patterns are derived names, not in any schema yet.
An org fragment (drg/fragment.yaml) has nodes and edges only, no header fields (DIV-008).
An edge carries no provenance (DIV-019); a shard node may.
Yellow «pending» / [pending …]: decided in the cited ADR,
but the cited open question is not ruled.
